operation.description:
Gets the total GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization.
The data fetched using this API is refreshed approximately every 5 minutes, so values returned from this endpoint may take at least 5 minutes to get updated.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Get GitHub Actions cache usage for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

total_active_caches_count.description: The count of active caches across all repositories of an enterprise or an organization.

total_active_caches_size_in_bytes.description: The total size in bytes of all active cache items across all repositories of an enterprise or an organization.
